CGO is enabled, which is expected for system-level Go applications interfacing with C libraries (e.g., PAM, systemd). The systemd user service file is installed and modified to use the system-wide binary path (`/usr/bin/`), which is a legitimate packaging adjustment.

No network operations, file exfiltration, obfuscated code, or unauthorized downloads are present. All operations are confined to standard build and installation procedures. The license, README, and binaries are installed in appropriate locations. Dependencies are reasonable for the described functionality.
